Name: Adaiah, Son of Jeroham, Priest
Summary: Son of Jeroham son of Pashur son of Malchijah, priest dwelling in Jerusalem.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 9:12: Son of Jeroham son of Pashur son of Malchijah, priest dwelling in Jerusalem.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Adaiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
